franklinton_c_B.interpretation_caveat: between h=12.91 and h=14.27 the domain developed 211 interior faces above 5 m/s at median Froude 3.65, reaching 12.1 m/s on the wbroad_hilltop probe. Water surfaces there are smooth and monotone and no depths are negative or non-finite, and Manning equilibrium for the same geometry gives 8.5 m/s, so this is not a numerical blow-up. But Fr 3.65 is outside the validity envelope of the Bates local-inertial scheme, which omits advection. Franklinton VELOCITIES on those cells are not defensible; depths are far less sensitive to the momentum closure and the road thresholds use depth.
